newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks seen easing ahead of holidays.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks seen easing ahead of holidays.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to open weak on Wednesday ahead of a four-day break for the Moslem festival of Eid al-Adha, dealers said.
They said a sell recommendation by Credit Lyonnais Securities Asia for market leader PTCL, Pakistan's telecom utility, might also dampen floor sentiment.

On Tuesday, the Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 2.46 points, or 0.16 percent, to end at 1,519.58. Losers led gainers 146 to 88. Turnover rose to 55 million shares from 54 million in the previous session.
